message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine is structured as a board game grid with nine main panels. The top banner features "GULA LANGKA SALAH SIAPA" and "MODUS CUCI UANG NURHADI" above the large word "TEMPO".

The central title, "jatuh BANGUN AHOK," is rendered in a blocky, stylized white font with black outlines. A cartoon man in a striped shirt and blue trousers walks along the top row. Below him, a white church with a cross steeple sits in a green-framed panel.

A blue panel shows a line-drawn man with glasses pointing upward. Adjacent to this, black text reads: "Basuki Tjahaja Purnama buka-bukaan soal pengalamannya di penjara, juga tentang kawan dan lawan politiknya. Wawancara eksklusif dengan Tempo." A panel to the right contains a geometric logo with blue, green, and red shapes.

The bottom row features a green panel with an obelisk-like monument and pricing text. A middle yellow panel shows a bulldozer, a purple snake winding through ladders, and a crowd of small silhouetted figures holding rectangular signs. A barcode and QR code occupy the bottom corners.
